_measurement_method: Pillow 11.x (Python 3.11) + NumPy. Pixel-level analysis. No OCR, no manual annotation, no estimation by memory.
_origin_note: Image is a GPT-generated render approved by the user as visual contract. It is NOT a screenshot of an existing app, therefore exact CSS/em values are not recoverable; we measure raster geometry only.

card_outer._method: Background = mean RGB of pixels (0..3, 0..3). Card body = pixels with color distance > 8 from background, measured per row across all 532 rows.
card_outer.corner_radius_estimate_px: ≈12 (left edge transitions from x=14 at y=0 to x=7 at y=12; symmetric on right). NOT measured by curve fit — estimated from edge transition only.
card_outer.border_thickness_px: não medido (1px border invisible against gradient at this resolution)
card_outer.shadow_glow: não medido (image has no transparent halo around card; if glow exists, it is part of the bg)

detected_inter_block_gaps._method: Per-row count of 'strong content' pixels (luminance>120 OR saturation>60). Quiet runs (strong<4) of length >=3 are inter-block separators. Coordinates are absolute y from image top.

blocks_approximate_yband._method: Y-bands inferred from gap detection above. Each block sits between two detected gaps. Y values are inclusive. THESE ARE APPROXIMATIONS, not segmentation-grade.
blocks_approximate_yband._caveat: Without per-pixel segmentation or OCR, exact x positions and widths of internal sub-elements are NOT measured.

02_header_status_due.x_layout: two pills, status left + due right, justify-space-between

04_enviado_por_box.notes: dark inner box with icon + Enviado por + author + date

05_cliente_label.y_top: não medido (vazio no print de referência)
05_cliente_label.notes: Not visible in reference render — block may be absent or empty in this fixture

06_title.notes: ULTRA label above + bold title 'Cronograma semanal'

07_chips.notes: 3 chips wrap row: Em produção / Cronograma / Semanal

09_etapa_proxima.notes: 'P SUA ETAPA Em produção' + 'PRÓXIMA Finalizar e entregar'

10_temas_box.notes: Box header 'TEMAS' + 3 rows (Tema 1 / 2 / 3 corrigido) + check circles right

12_date.y_top: merged with 11 in detection — não separável sem OCR

blocks_approximate_yband.14_border_glow_shadow: não medido como camada separada (image flatten)
blocks_approximate_yband.16_menu_dots: ícone ⋯ visível no rodapé; menu flutuante por definição não está aberto na referência

color_samples_sparse._method: Direct pixel reads at probed coordinates. Many probes hit card-background instead of intended element due to lack of segmentation. Reporting only colors that are unambiguously content.
color_samples_sparse.other_chip_and_text_colors: não medido com confiança sem segmentação manual

not_measured: exact px-level position of each sub-element within a block
exact font sizes (image is raster; no metadata)
shadow/glow extent (no alpha halo in image)
chip backgrounds and text colors (sampling unreliable without segmentation)
exact gap between each pair of adjacent elements at sub-block level
measurement_limitations: Reference image is 280×532 RGBA. Card occupies essentially the entire image with no transparent halo, so 'glow' / 'shadow' cannot be measured as a separate layer.
GPT-generated renders may contain non-pixel-perfect blocks (rendered text rather than from a real DOM); measurements are of the rendered raster, not of CSS values.
All y-bands for blocks 02..13 are inferred from inter-block gap detection. They are approximate (±a few px) and should be used as a coarse vertical layout contract, not as a sub-pixel spec.
X-positions of internal elements were NOT systematically measured (would require per-block segmentation).
